statement.p: Use polynomial fitting to find the formula for the nth term of the sequence (a_n)_{n \ge 1} which starts,
{5, 36, 107, 236, 441}, \ldots Note the first term above is a_1, not a_0.

solution.p: a_n = {3n^{3}+2n^{2}+4n-4}\text{.} Here we know that we are looking for a cubic because the third differences are constant. So a_n = an^3 + bn^2 + cn + d\text{.} We can work backwards to find that a_0 = {-4}, so we know d= {-4}\text{.} Then solve the system,
to find a = {3}, b = {2}, and c = {4}.
